mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_info WHERE status = 0) AS userTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM author_info) AS authorTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_info WHERE audit_status = 2) AS bookTotal, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_comment WHERE audit_status = 1) AS commentTotal
SELECT DATE(create_time) AS day, COUNT(*) AS num FROM user_info WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY day
SELECT DATE(create_time) AS day, COUNT(*) AS num FROM book_info WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY day
SELECT DATE(create_time) AS day, COUNT(*) AS num FROM book_comment WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY day
